newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ shares ends end with modest gain, BIL eases.
newsitem.headline: NZ shares ends end with modest gain, BIL eases.

text.p: * New Zealand share prices end with modest gain
* Brierley eases after setting Thistle price
* Market takes on more robust tone, pre-election
Price movements at close
LAST CHG
326 +2 * NZSC cap index +0.45 at 4,387.04
286 nil * NZSE-10 cap index +4.35 at 1,120.69
355 -3 * Volume NZ$39 million. Futures +10 at 1,127
689 +4 * Other movers - +9 +6
New Zealand share prices, assisted by a rally in the bond market, ended firmer on Wednesday after re-couping all of Monday's losses over the past two days.
The NZSE-40 Capital Index ended 8.78 points higher at 2,221.35 on moderate turnover of NZ$39 million.

"There is, I think, an emerging feeling now that the election outcome, even if it goes to the left, is not as fearful as was previously thought because it looks like Labour will hold the whip hand," John Rattray at Ord Minnett said.
"Financial markets are not too uncomfortable with the prospect of (Labour's) Michael Cullen being finance minister," he said.

"Provided Labour is the dominant part of a coalition to the left then I think the markets can live with that and I think that's what the bond, equity and foreign exchange markets are saying," he said.

An election under the new proportional voting system is due on October 12, and parties of the left, led by Labour, look capable of dislodging the conservative government if recent opinion polls prove accurate.
"The chances of the market coming through this are starting to look better," Rattray said.
Brierley Investments was marked back by two cents to NZ$1.37 amid disappointment that it pitched its price for the U.K. Thistle Hotels float at just 170 pence against some expectations of 190.

However, brokers doubted there would be further downside for BIL as it got close to downsizing its exposure to the British hotels group. Most of the other leaders performed strongly, many of them as a result of strength in the bond market.
